```yaml
name: Playwright Docs Check

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - release-*
    paths:
      - 'openmetadata-ui/**'
      - 'playwright/**'
      - '.github/workflows/playwright-docs-check.yml'

jobs:
  playwright-docs-check:
    name: Playwright Docs Check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: openmetadata-ui/package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: openmetadata-ui
        run: npm ci

      - name: Install Playwright Browsers
        working-directory: openmetadata-ui
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

      - name: Run Playwright Docs Tests
        working-directory: openmetadata-ui
        run: npx playwright test --project=docs
        env:
          CI: true
          PLAYWRIGHT_TEST_BASE_URL: http://localhost:3000

      - name: Upload Playwright Report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: openmetadata-ui/playwright-report/
          retention-days: 30
```
